A 25th century year in the Gregorian calendar is the year 2025. The Gregorian calendar counts centuries by dividing the number of years into groups of 100 years. Therefore, the 1st century began on January 1, 01, and ended on December 31, 100, the 2nd century began on January 1, 101, and ended on December 31, 200, and so on. The 25th century, therefore, would be the century that begins on January 1, 2001, and ends on December 31, 2100, but since 2100 is the start of the 26th century, the 25th century actually ends on December 31, 2099, and begins on January 1, 2100.
